hints.brightness: Lightens or darkens the midtones; black and white stay.
hints.contrast: Increases or reduces the difference between light and dark.
hints.highlights: Recovers or brightens the bright areas, such as a sky.
hints.shadows: Opens up or deepens the dark areas.
hints.warmth: Shifts colours towards amber or blue.
hints.tint: Shifts colours towards magenta or green.
hints.saturation: Strengthens all colours, or moves them towards grey.
hints.vibrance: Strengthens muted colours first; skin tones are protected.
hints.dehaze: Removes haze (+) or adds a soft haze (−).
hints.grain: Adds film grain, strongest in the midtones; the same size in mm at every print size.
hints.grainSize: From fine to coarse grain, in millimetres on the print.
hints.vignette: Darkens (−) or lightens (+) the corners of the cropped photo.
hints.fade: Lifts the blacks for a matte print.
hints.shadowTint: Adds a colour to the shadows.
hints.highlightTint: Adds a colour to the highlights.
hints.balance: Sets where the shadow tint ends and the highlight tint begins.
hints.mono: Converts to black and white through a colour filter; red darkens blue skies most.
hints.amount: How much of the whole look: every slider and its LUT together
hints.lutStrength: How much of the imported LUT, before the sliders

welcome.text: Open a folder of photos from a trip, or drop one on the window. Fotollection works on them where they are: nothing is copied, moved or uploaded.
welcome.alt: The gallery of a trip's photos

modes.title: Three modes
modes.text: Simple to keep or drop and print at once, Collage for two photos to a print or postcards, Pro for stars, best shots, crop and colour. {{mod}} 1, 2 and 3 switch between them.

choose.title: Choose the best
choose.text: Find best shots groups the bursts and keeps the best of each in the Workspace; the others go to Set aside. Press ↑ to put a photo in the print basket.

develop.title: Edit and stamp
develop.text: Open a photo to set its colour, crop it to the print size and stamp the date and town; the info frame adds the camera and lens.

print.title: Print
print.text: Export writes the photos at the shop's sizes, ready for a self-service kiosk or an online lab. Settings → Export keeps your choices for next time.

motion.label: Motion
motion.systemHint: Follows the system's Reduce motion setting.
motion.reduceHint: Slides and zooms become short fades.

part.failed: This panel stopped on an error; the rest still works (ERR-UI-0001).
part.appFailed: Fotollection stopped on an error (ERR-UI-0001). Reload to continue.

move.title: Move to another computer
move.how: On this computer, export your settings and copy your .fotollection projects. On the other, import the settings, open each project and relink its photo folders.
move.addressesHint: Includes typed postcard addresses; off by default.
move.exportHint: Settings, saved looks, LUTs, fonts and logos in one .fotosettings file; no photos or projects.
move.importHint: Shows the file's contents before importing.

stores.title: What Fotollection keeps here
stores.unusedHint: LUTs no saved look, photo or setting uses. A project saved before v0.14.0 may still need them.

reset.title: Reset
reset.settingsHint: The interface, export choices, defaults for new projects and cameras' typed names go back to their defaults; your looks, LUTs, fonts, logos and addresses stay.
reset.eraseHint: Deletes saved looks, LUTs, fonts, logos and addresses. Projects and photos are not affected.

luts.title: Remove unused LUTs?
luts.body: LUT files no look, photo or setting uses are deleted. A project saved before v0.14.0 that used one opens without it.

addresses.title: Forget recent addresses?
addresses.body: Recent postcard addresses are removed; written postcards keep theirs.

reset.title: Reset settings?
reset.body: The settings go back to their defaults; your looks, LUTs, fonts, logos and addresses stay. The old settings are kept as settings.json.bak.

erase.title: Erase data?
erase.body: Your saved looks, LUTs, fonts, logos and addresses are deleted from this computer. Projects and photos are not affected. The old settings are kept as settings.json.bak.

import.title: Import settings
import.mergeHint: Adds what this computer lacks; its interface and defaults stay.
import.replaceHint: Uses the file's settings whole; this computer's are kept as settings.json.bak.

addassist.title: Address entry
addassist.assistedHint: The postal code or a search fills the places from the post's data, offline
addassist.name: Name
addassist.latin: Print the address in Latin letters
addassist.none: Not found: try another code or place, or type it by hand.
addassist.latinHint: The places in romaji or Revised Romanization; what you type prints as typed.
addassist.enterHint: Press Enter to look it up.

toDelete.deleteBody: The files move to the system Trash and can be restored from there.
toDelete.forGoodTitle_one: {{count}} photo could not go to the Trash
toDelete.forGoodTitle_other: {{count}} photos could not go to the Trash
toDelete.forGoodBody: Their drive has no Trash (common on network drives). Delete them permanently? This cannot be undone.
toDelete.hint: Tick photos to restore them; Enter opens them one by one.
toDelete.empty: No photos marked to delete. Press Delete on a photo, or mark a group in RollSense.
toDelete.noTrash_one: {{count}} photo is on a drive that may have no Trash: it would be deleted permanently.
toDelete.noTrash_other: {{count}} photos are on a drive that may have no Trash: they would be deleted permanently.

rollsense.title: RollSense
rollsense.hint: Tick photos, then edit them in Photos, add them to the print basket, set them aside or mark them to delete.
rollsense.alsoFiltered: The star and flag filter in Photos is on; RollSense shows only matching photos.
rollsense.toBasket_one: Add {{count}} photo to the print basket
rollsense.toBasket_other: Add {{count}} photos to the print basket
